messages.subject: Issue with Order L-37024
messages.text:
Hello,
 

 I purchased 4 packs of seed bombs back in June 2025 (order L-37024) and planted them a few days after I received the shipment. Unfortunately, nothing has grown yet in the area. Here is a photo of the area showing only mulberry and dandelion weeds:
 
 20250905_182127.jpg (https://drive.google.com/open?id=1LEU2H_YtYURG9WW9O5vhLvC-d3g8bcwm)

 I was wondering what Lasclay can do regarding this issue since nothing has grown in over two months?
 

 Thank you,
 

 Jason Kruski
